jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer AI & Agents
jobs.description: About Inflection AI Inflection AI is a Public Benefit Corporation empowering people with human-centered, emotionally intelligent AI. We’re shaping the future of AI by combining emotional intelligence (EQ) and raw intelligence (IQ) to elevate people’s potential. Inflection AI created Pi, the world’s first emotionally intelligent AI, to help people work through decisions, emotions, and challenges. Pi is a personal AI agent powered by Inflection AI’s foundation model, proving that AI can be personal, empathetic, and contextually aware. About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled and technical Senior Product Manager to help contribute to the development and evolution of our Consumer AI & Agents systems. You will report to the Head of Product for Customer Journeys and work cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, UXR, Data Analytics, Marketing, and Legal. The ideal candidate will be adept at working closely with research and engineering teams to translate advanced AI capabilities into practical, user-centric product design. You will be responsible for translating complex technical capabilities into delightful and convenient experiences for the world’s consumers as well as partnering with engineering and research to bring new technical capabilities into product experiences in this unprecedented moment of rapid technical change. What You'll Do Focus on the User: Use a combination of user research, data analysis, and A/B testing to guide product decisions and ensure we are building a product that is intuitive, trustworthy, and genuinely helpful. Understand the Technology: Work closely with the underlying technology of the Inflection AI platform, including our proprietary LLMs and voice models, our fine-tuning processes for open-source models (e.g., Nemotron, Qwen, GPT-OSS), and our systems for constrained inference, memory, profile, and journeys. Define and Drive the Roadmap: Contribute to the product strategy and own execution of the roadmap for your product area within Consumer AI & Agents Drive Execution: Partner with engineering and research teams to deliver on the opportunity for elevating the human experience. Write detailed product requirements and technical specifications, define user stories, and manage the backlog in a fast-paced environment. Deliver cross-platform features that impact millions of users globally, ensuring high reliability, performance, and scalability. Apply Technical Expertise: Demonstrate strong technical fluency in algorithms, distributed systems, and ML model optimization to evaluate design decisions, guide engineering trade-offs, and ensure product scalability and reliability. Measure Success: Define, monitor, and analyze key product metrics such as engagement, retention, user satisfaction, and adoption of new capabilities. Partner with data science and analytics to run large-scale experiments (A/B and multivariate) and translate insights into product strategy. Communicate Effectively: Collaborate cross-functionally and communicate priorities and progress to stakeholders and the broader team. Who You Are (Minimum Qualifications) 5-8 years of total experience, with 3+ years of product management experience, including shipping and scaling consumer-facing mobile (iOS/Android) and web products. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field (advanced degree preferred). The role requires advanced knowledge of computer science and AI/ML systems. Experience working on products powered by AI/ML technologies is strongly preferred, including familiarity with APIs, inference systems, and distributed architectures. Strong technical foundation with the ability to engage in substantive discussions with ML researchers and systems engineers, applying knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and model optimization. Ability to apply advanced computer science principles to product design and translate complex AI/ML systems into user-facing features. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field. Proven experience as a PM for products built directly on Large Language Models (LLMs), conversational AI, or autonomous agent frameworks. Technical fluency in the modern AI landscape, with an ability to discuss the trade-offs between proprietary vs. open-source models, various fine-tuning techniques, and the architectural patterns for building AI agents. Experience taking products from initial concept to significant scale (0-to-1). Experience mentoring other PMs or leading cross-functional product initiatives at scale. Strong product sense and user empathy, with a proven ability to deliver well-designed and intuitive user experiences. An entrepreneurial mindset: you are comfortable with ambiguity, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and have a bias for action. Employee Pay Disclosures At Inflection AI, we aim to attract and retain the best employees and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contributions to the company. For this role, Inflection AI estimates a starting annual base salary to fall within the range of $ 234,000 to $ 375,000 , depending on a candidate’s qualifications and level of experience. This role also includes a meaningful equity component, allowing employees to share in the long-term success of the company. Benefits Inflection AI values and supports our team’s mental and physical health. We are focused on building a positive, safe, inclusive and inspiring place to work. Our benefits include: Diverse medical, dental and vision options 401k matching program Unlimited paid time off Parental leave and flexibility for all parents and caregivers Support of country-specific visa needs for international employees living in the Bay Area

jobs.title: Director of AI Transformation
jobs.location: Reno, NV; Walnut Creek, California, United States
jobs.description: About ITS Logistics Are you ready to build a successful career while disrupting a trillion-dollar global industry? ITS Logistics is one of the largest, fastest growing, exciting logistics companies in the United States providing creative supply chain solutions to Fortune 500 companies. With unmatched agility, sense of urgency, and work ethic, ITS commits to a relentless pursuit of excellence and leading from the front to keep the world moving, every day. We need the best talent to continue to invest, grow and win every day and are looking for people with the right mindset – honest, adaptable, and committed. We empower you to seize every opportunity and thrive in a fast paced, ever-changing environment. Do you have what it takes? Find out today - www.its4logistics.com . Principle accountabilities We are seeking a Director of AI Transformation with an entrepreneurial mindset - someone who has operated in startup environments, thrives in change, and is driven to disrupt and redefine how logistics operates at its core! This is not a traditional AI or automation role. Reporting directly to the Chief Operations Officer (COO), this leader will identify, build, and scale our AI-powered strategies and capabilities that will supercharge how we operate. You will act as an internal founder - challenging assumptions, moving quickly, and creating solutions across every aspect of our business, from business services to warehousing to transportation. AI-Led Business Innovation Identify and build new AI-driven capabilities that unlock revenue, margin expansion, and market differentiation. Develop proprietary approaches to pricing, capacity, and decision-making that separate ITS from traditional asset-lite companies. Partner directly with leadership to shape the future state of the business - not just optimize the current one. Build internal models, platforms, and systems that drive efficiency and exponential growth. Product & Platform Development Operate like a startup founder within the business - taking ideas from concept to deployed solutions quickly. Maintain a close partnership with our IT organization, maximizing all products and development across our organization. Rapidly test, iterate, and refine ideas based on business impact - not perfection. Disruption of Core Industry Workflows Challenge deeply embedded ways of working across logistics and operations, and warehousing. Replace legacy thinking - not just legacy tools - with AI-native approaches to execution and decision-making. Introduce new ways of interacting with data, customers, and capacity. Drive a culture of rapid experimentation and high-velocity execution, delivering visible wins quickly while building toward larger, transformative outcomes. Prioritize initiatives based on measurable business impact (revenue, margin, speed, win rate, etc.). AI Strategy & Market Positioning Ensure ITS leverages cutting-edge, market-leading AI tools in a rapidly evolving landscape. Partner cross-functionally to define and execute the company’s AI transformation roadmap. Establish best practices for responsible and effective AI usage across teams. In conjunction with ITS in-house CIO, ensure enterprise AI tools and data are leveraged securely. Help position ITS as a technology-forward disruptor in logistics, not a follower. Who you are Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Economics, or a related field preferred. 3–5 years of experience in AI, data systems, automation, or technical/product-oriented roles. Startup or entrepreneurial experience - you’ve built something from scratch, operated in change, or owned outcomes end-to-end. A builder first, not just a strategist- you execute, iterate, and ship. Think in terms of products, systems, and leverage - not tasks or workflows. Comfortable challenging leadership and rethinking how an industry should operate. Experience applying AI (LLMs, automation, data systems) to drive real business outcomes - not just experimentation. You move fast, prioritize impact, and are energized by creating something new vs. optimizing what exists. Background in logistics is helpful, but outsider thinking is highly valued. Willing to relocate to Reno, NV; hybrid option available for SF Bay Area candidates with ~60% time in Reno.

jobs.title: AI Strategy & Transformation Architect
jobs.location: Remote - Canada (Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario Only)
jobs.description: Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture: At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, Amazon, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies. We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space. Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you. Required Qualifications: 10+ years of experience in management consulting, enterprise strategy, or digital transformation Proven experience defining and operationalizing agentic AI use cases Strong understanding of AI/LLM platforms and ecosystems (e.g., Salesforce Agentforce/Einstein, OpenAI, AWS, Azure) and their business applications Expertise in translating emerging technology into business value, ROI, and measurable outcomes Deep proficiency in Salesforce platform strategy (Sales, Service, Data Cloud, AI), including ecosystem integration Understanding of contact center technologies, business processes, and metrics a big plus Experience with business architecture and operating model design (capability models, value streams, target state roadmaps) Ability to connect business strategy to execution, partnering closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams Experience leading executive-level conversations, workshops, and strategic decision forums Strong storytelling and communication skills with dynamic and engaging personality, simplifying complex concepts for senior stakeholders Working knowledge of AI governance, risk, ethics, and compliance, particularly in regulated environments Comfort operating in ambiguity and shaping problem statements in early-stage strategy engagements Experience contributing to practice development, frameworks, or thought leadership What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture? Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team. Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients. Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small. Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.
